name: iphone-mockup
title: iPhone 15 Pro Mockup
blurb: SVG iPhone 15 mockup frame displays images with hardware notch.
description: An SVG-rendered iPhone 15 Pro mockup displaying an image within the screen cutout. Includes accurate notch geometry, side buttons, and rounded corners via clip-path.
use_when: App landing pages, product showcases, and marketing materials displaying mobile screenshots.
avoid_when: When responsive sizing is needed; width/height are fixed props and don't scale automatically.
a11y: SVG image element uses href; no native alt text support on embedded images.
